macro_area.label: Commercial
macro_area.description: Describe authority to market the property and its commercial representation.

subareas.label: Acquisition, Brokerage Mandate and Intermediation
subareas.description: Authority, mandate, brokerage relationships and commercial intermediation.

dictionary_terms.label: Office Name
dictionary_terms.description: The legal name of the brokerage.

dictionary_terms.label: Office Name
dictionary_terms.description: The legal name of the brokerage.

dictionary_terms.label: List Team
dictionary_terms.description: Two or more agents working on the listing agent's team.

dictionary_terms.label: Room Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of identifiers for specific interior spaces within a structure (e.g., Bedroom, Bathroom, Kitchen, Living Room). A relational implementation of rooms must omit the type from the field name and use RoomType to create a vertical representation of the various rooms. Note that garage or basement should not be added as a room type, as these are represented by the ParkingFeatures and Basement fields, respectively.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Team
dictionary_terms.description: Two or more agents working on the buyer agent's team.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent
dictionary_terms.description: The listing agent involved in the transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent
dictionary_terms.description: The buyer's agent involved in the transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing URL
dictionary_terms.description: Provides a link to the specific listing on a brokerage website, agent website or other public-facing source.

dictionary_terms.label: List Office
dictionary_terms.description: The listing agent's office.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Office
dictionary_terms.description: The buyer agent's office.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent
dictionary_terms.description: The co-listing agent involved in the transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: Concessions
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not there are concessions included in the sales agreement (i.e., Yes, No or Call Listing Agent).

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent
dictionary_terms.description: The co-buyer's agent involved in the transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Office
dictionary_terms.description: The co-listing agent's office.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent AOR
dictionary_terms.description: The listing agent's board or association of REALTORS®.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent Fax
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the ListAgentKey is the system unique identifier from the system where the record was retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId. This is a foreign key relating to the Member Resource's MemberKey.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent URL
dictionary_terms.description: The website Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the listing agent.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of floor plans or configurations of an individual unit (e.g., 1 Bedroom, Studio, Loft) in a multi-family or multi-unit development. A relational implementation of UnitTypes must omit the type from the field name and use UnitTypeType to create a vertical representation of the various unit types. Repeating of the word "type" in the field name is intentional.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent AOR
dictionary_terms.description: The buyer agent's board or association of REALTORS®.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent Fax
dictionary_terms.description: The North American 10-digit fax numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the key is the system unique identifier from the system in which the record was just retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set. This is a foreign key relating to the Member Resource's MemberKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent URL
dictionary_terms.description: The website Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the buyers agent.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Office
dictionary_terms.description: The co-buyer agent's office.

dictionary_terms.label: Withdrawn Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date that the listing was withdrawn from the market. This is not when a listing contract was canceled or closed, but a withdrawal from the market while the contract between the seller and listing agent is still in effect and an offer has not been accepted. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Activation Date
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates when the listing agent intends to change the property to the Active status.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent AOR
dictionary_terms.description: The Co-listing Agent's board or association of REALTORS®.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent Fax
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the key is the system unique identifier from the system where the record was just retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set. This is a foreign key relating to the Member Resource's MemberKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent URL
dictionary_terms.description: The website Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the co-listing agent.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent Email
dictionary_terms.description: The email address of the listing agent.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent MLS ID
dictionary_terms.description: The local, well-known identifier for the member. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, and it should be the identifier from the original system.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent Pager
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: List Office Name
dictionary_terms.description: The legal name of the brokerage representing the seller.

dictionary_terms.label: Standard Status
dictionary_terms.description: The status of the listing as it reflects the state of the contract between the listing agent and seller, or an agreement with a buyer (e.g., Active, Active Under Contract, Canceled, Closed, Expired, Pending, Withdrawn). This is a single-select field.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent Email
dictionary_terms.description: The email address of the buyer's agent.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent MLS ID
dictionary_terms.description: The local, well-known identifier. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, and it should be the identifier from the original system.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Agent Pager
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Office Name
dictionary_terms.description: The legal name of the brokerage representing the buyer.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent AOR
dictionary_terms.description: The co-buyer agent's board or association of REALTORS®.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent Fax
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the key is the system unique identifier from the system where the record was just retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set. This is a foreign key relating to the Member Resource's MemberKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent URL
dictionary_terms.description: The website Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the co-buyers agent.

dictionary_terms.label: Unparsed Address
dictionary_terms.description: A text representation of the address with the full civic location as a single entity. It may optionally include any of City, StateOrProvince, PostalCode and Country.

dictionary_terms.label: Cancellation Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date that the listing contract between the seller and listing agent was canceled. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent Email
dictionary_terms.description: The email address of the co-listing agent.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent MLS ID
dictionary_terms.description: The local, well-known identifier. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, and it should be the identifier from the original system.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Agent Pager
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-List Office Name
dictionary_terms.description: The legal name of the brokerage co-representing the seller.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Agreement
dictionary_terms.description: The nature of the agreement between the seller and the listing agent (e.g., Exclusive Agency, Open Listing).

dictionary_terms.label: Start Showing Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date the listing agent/broker expects to start showing the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent Email
dictionary_terms.description: The email address of the buyer's co-agent.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent MLS ID
dictionary_terms.description: The local, well-known identifier. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, and it should be the identifier from the original system.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Agent Pager
dictionary_terms.description: North American 10-digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

dictionary_terms.label: Co-Buyer Office Name
dictionary_terms.description: The legal name of the brokerage co-representing the buyer.

subareas.label: Commercial Offering, Listing and Publication
subareas.description: Commercial offer, listing content, publication channels and media representation.

dictionary_terms.label: Order
dictionary_terms.description: Only a positive integer, including zero. Element zero is the primary photo per RESO convention.

dictionary_terms.label: Image Of
dictionary_terms.description: When the media is an image, a list of possible matches such as kitchen, bathroom, front of structure, etc. This field may be used to identify a required image under association or MLS rules.

dictionary_terms.label: City
dictionary_terms.description: The city in the listing address.

dictionary_terms.label: Media Key
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for this record from the immediate source. This may be a number or a string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the system you are connecting to and not necessarily the original source of the record.

dictionary_terms.label: Media URL
dictionary_terms.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) to the media file referenced by this record.

dictionary_terms.label: Media
dictionary_terms.description: A collection of media items related to the Property record.

dictionary_terms.label: Class Name
dictionary_terms.description: The class or table of the listing or other record of the media (e.g., Residential, Lease, Agent, Office, Contact).

dictionary_terms.label: Feed Types
dictionary_terms.description: A list of feeds that the given record is included in.

dictionary_terms.label: Media HTML
dictionary_terms.description: The JavaScript or other method to embed a video, image, virtual tour or other media.

dictionary_terms.label: Media Type
dictionary_terms.description: Media types as defined by the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA), http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/index.html. Note that the former name of MimeType, used by both IANA and RESO, may still be in use by some systems/entities.

dictionary_terms.label: Zoning
dictionary_terms.description: A division of the city or county into areas of different permissible land uses. This field should be used for the short code that is commonly used. For full textual descriptions, please use the ZoningDescription field.

dictionary_terms.label: Image Width
dictionary_terms.description: The width of the image expressed in pixels.

dictionary_terms.label: Permission
dictionary_terms.description: The permission-level of the media (i.e., Public, Private, IDX, VOW, Office Only, Firm Only, Agent Only).

dictionary_terms.label: Cap Rate
dictionary_terms.description: The equivalent to the return on investment you would receive if you pay cash for a property. The ratio between the net operating income produced by an asset and its capital cost (the original price paid to buy the asset) or alternatively its current market value.

dictionary_terms.label: List AOR
dictionary_terms.description: The responsible board or association of REALTORS® for this listing.

dictionary_terms.label: Image Height
dictionary_terms.description: The height of the image expressed in pixels.

dictionary_terms.label: Media Status
dictionary_terms.description: The status of the media item referenced by this record (i.e., updated, deleted, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Garage Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: A flag that indicates whether or not the listing has a garage. This flag may be true/false, yes/no or some other true, false or unknown indicator. As with all flags, the field may be null.

dictionary_terms.label: List Team
dictionary_terms.description: Two or more agents working on the listing agent's team.

dictionary_terms.label: Resource Name
dictionary_terms.description: The resource or table of the listing or other record the media relates to (i.e., Property, Member, Office, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Source System
dictionary_terms.description: The source system of the Media record.

dictionary_terms.label: Auction Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether the property is available for auction.

dictionary_terms.label: Carport Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: A flag indicating that the listing has a carport. This flag may be true/false, yes/no or another true, false or unknown indicator. As with all flags, the field may be null.

dictionary_terms.label: Close Date
dictionary_terms.description: With for-sale listings, this is the date the purchase agreement was fulfilled. With lease listings, it is the date the requirements were fulfilled, such as contract and/or deposit. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Days in MLS
dictionary_terms.description: The number of days the listing was on market within the MLS system. Like Days on Market, where the calculation can be based on a number of on-market and off-market events, Days in MLS is best defined as being based upon timestamps of when entry or changes were made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Feed Types
dictionary_terms.description: A list of feeds that the given record is included in.
